In states that have seen reproductive access drastically curtailed since the end of Roe v. Wade, newly empowered Democratic governors and lawmakers could repeal abortion restrictions, codify new protections, and work toward enshrining reproductive freedom in state constitutions. Democratic attorneys general could stop enforcing draconian laws that threaten abortion providers and helpers with prosecution and reject efforts to criminalize pregnancy loss. In Congress, even with Donald Trump in the White House, Democrats will have expansive new powers to pass federal abortion-rights bills, claw back cuts to Medicaid and healthcare funding, and block confirmation of anti-abortion federal judges and far-right cabinet nominees.
